messages:
sylvia (Marketing): Heads-up team — upcoming launch push for the "Inference Economics" webinar. Need a focused mini-pack + an editable inbound routing SVG for SDRs. Low friction, on-brand. Goal: push Apr 18.

diego (Design): OK. What files are must-haves?

sylvia (Marketing): Minimal bundle: hero 1200x628 (static + GIF fallback), 3 social squares 1080x1080, 1 story 1080x1920, email header 600x200, claim badge 760x400 (landing-ready), and inbound_routing_editable.svg. Also speaker headshots cropped to 1:1.

kevin (Growth): Routing specifics: landing -> short form -> lead score -> auto-assign -> AE / Growth nurture / Enterprise SDR. Add replay viewers -> nurture only. Include UTM template and mapping to team owners in legend.

diego (Design): Got it. I'll include a tiny legend block with UTM example and color-coded queues. Prefer to get final copy by Apr 10 to hit Apr 14 internal review.

amelia (Brand): Brand rules: no gradients, use icon-set v3, CTA color = brand-accent-3. If you show a stat callout, it must reference the benchmark slide or be a placeholder. Keep clearspace and type tokens.

yuki (Localization): I can localize JP/KR if English copy is final by Apr 8. Short social microcopy needs tone notes and max chars.

sylvia (Marketing): Two CTA variants for A/B: A = "See serving savings" B = "Watch cost demo". Kevin please map UTMs (A -> utm_campaign=inference_A, B -> inference_B).

legal-bot: Reminder: numeric percentage claims require upload of the benchmark CSV + run date. Qualitative phrasing OK for now (e.g., "reduced per-token cost"). No competitor names.

diego (Design): Export rules: PNG for socials, GIF for hero (max 3s loop), SVG for routing with editable layers. I'll post Figma starter link and frame names prefixed "APR18_MINIPACK".

kevin (Growth): I'll post the UTM sheet and lead-owner mapping by Apr 6. Also add the sample auto-assign rule to the legend: "score>=50 -> AE; 20-49 -> Growth; <20 -> nurture."

amelia (Brand): Accessibility check: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text and prominent CTAs meet accessible tap sizes. Motion must avoid flashing.

diego (Design): Timeline: first pass Apr 5, internal review Apr 6-7, localization overlays Apr 8-9, final export Apr 10 AM. If copy slips I can deliver text placeholders for quick overlays.

sylvia (Marketing): Perfect — Diego, please drop Figma link + an export filename checklist when first pass is up. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
